pub_start_intro: BudgetMaster is a calm money app for your phone. Record a purchase in a few seconds, keep budgets that start on payday, and see where your money went, alone or with a partner.
pub_start_demo_note: The demo is a private copy of 14 months of sample data, deleted after 48 hours unless you sign up. No card, no email.
pub_start_privacy_text: No ads, no tracking, no bank passwords. Export everything at any time, delete your account in one step, and sign in with a passkey or two-step sign-in.
pub_about_description: BudgetMaster is a mobile-first app for tracking income, expenses and budgets, alone or shared with a partner.
pub_about_intro: BudgetMaster is a mobile-first personal finance app. It answers three questions: where did my money go, how much can I still spend this month, and what is coming up. It is built and run by Ákos Kappel as a personal project.
pub_about_f_quick: Record income, expenses and transfers in a few seconds with quick add, or type a line like "coffee 3.20 cash yesterday". Known payees fill in their usual category and wallet, and one receipt can be split across several categories.
pub_about_f_wallets: Track wallets for bank accounts, cards, cash and savings, each in its own currency, with balances that follow every transaction.
pub_about_f_budgets: Set a monthly budget and limits per category. The budget month can start on payday, unspent money can carry over, and a pace chart shows whether you are on track.
pub_about_f_recurring: Let salary, rent and subscriptions record themselves with recurring payments, and pause them when they stop.
pub_about_f_reports: See reports: cash flow, net worth, where the money went, a spending calendar, a 90-day forecast, a printable monthly report and a year in review.
pub_about_f_import: Import a bank statement as CSV: review every row, skip duplicates, and undo an import later. The layout of your bank's file is remembered.
pub_about_f_goals: Save towards goals, attach receipt photos, and get hints worth a look, such as a double charge or a subscription that got more expensive.
pub_about_f_categories: Organise spending with categories and subcategories, tags and rules that fill in the category for known payees.
pub_about_f_search: Search and filter every transaction by text, type, category, wallet, tag, date and amount. Filters stay in the link, so you can bookmark them.
pub_about_f_share: Share a space with a partner or flatmates: invite people by link, choose who can edit and who can only look, record who paid, and settle up.
pub_about_f_more: Undo a change, find anything with the command palette (Ctrl+K), install it on your phone, use it in English, Hungarian or Slovak, and switch between light and dark mode.
pub_about_f_data: Download all your data as JSON or a space's transactions as CSV, and delete your account whenever you want.
pub_about_try_text: to get a private copy of 14 months of sample data without signing up. It is deleted after 48 hours unless you create an account.

pub_faq_description: Answers to common questions about BudgetMaster.
pub_faq_free_a: Yes. There are no paid plans and no ads.
pub_faq_bank_q: Does it connect to my bank?
pub_faq_bank_a: No. You record transactions yourself; quick add, payee memory and recurring payments keep that to a few seconds. A CSV export from your bank can be imported, with a review of every row.
pub_faq_currency_a: Each wallet has its own currency, and transfers between currencies record both amounts. Totals, budgets and reports convert other currencies into the space currency with the European Central Bank's daily reference rates.
pub_faq_share_q: Can I share it with my partner?
pub_faq_share_a: Yes. Create a shared space under More, Spaces and send an invite link. Everyone keeps their own personal space next to it.
pub_faq_split_q: We pay for some things ourselves. Can it split costs?
pub_faq_split_a: Yes. In a shared space, set "Paid by" when someone paid from their own money (a wallet like "Out of pocket" keeps track of it). The space page shows who owes whom, suggests the payments that settle everything and records them.
pub_faq_demo_q: What happens to the demo data?
pub_faq_demo_a: Every demo is private to you. It is deleted 48 hours after you start it, unless you create an account from the banner; then you keep everything.
pub_faq_data_q: How do I get my data out, or delete it?
pub_faq_data_a: Under Settings, Your data: download everything as JSON or a space as CSV, or delete your account with all spaces only you belong to.
pub_faq_bug_q: I found a bug or a security problem.
pub_faq_bug_a: Bugs go to the issue tracker on GitHub. For security problems, see the
pub_privacy_description: What BudgetMaster stores, why, and how to take it with you.
pub_privacy_intro: BudgetMaster is a personal project by Ákos Kappel. Your financial data is yours: it is used only to run the app for you and the people you share a space with.
pub_privacy_s_account: Your name, email address and a hash of your password.
pub_privacy_s_entered: What you enter: wallets, transactions, categories, tags, budgets, savings goals, recurring payments and the spaces you belong to.
pub_privacy_s_sessions: Sessions: when you signed in, the IP address and the browser, so you stay signed in and sign-in attempts can be limited.
pub_privacy_s_two_step: With two-step sign-in on: the authenticator key and your backup codes, both encrypted.
pub_privacy_s_receipts: Receipt photos you attach, made smaller in your browser before the upload. They are stored with the transaction, only members of its space can open them, and they are deleted with it.
pub_privacy_s_ai: Only if you switch on AI features in Settings and tap an AI button: what that feature needs goes to Anthropic's Claude API, that is the receipt photo, the typed line, the PDF statement, or the totals for a monthly summary or a question, with your wallet and category names. The transactions stored in the app are not sent one by one, and nothing else is.
pub_privacy_s_log: A log of who added, changed or deleted which transaction, shown to the members of a shared space.
pub_privacy_s_social: If you sign in with Google, GitHub, Apple or Microsoft: that account's id, name, email address and profile picture link. Nothing else from it is read.
pub_privacy_s_passkeys: Passkeys you add: their public key and a name. The private key never leaves your device.
pub_privacy_cookies_intro: Only cookies the app needs, no tracking or advertising cookies:
pub_privacy_c_session: The Better Auth session cookies, to keep you signed in.
pub_privacy_c_two_step: With two-step sign-in on: a short-lived cookie between the password and the code, and one for 30 days if you trust the browser.
pub_privacy_c_space: the space you looked at last.
pub_privacy_c_tz: your time zone, so "today" matches your clock.
pub_privacy_who_text: Nobody else, except members of a shared space, who see that space's data. There is no analytics, no advertising and no third-party tracking, and data is never sold. The app and its database run on a server operated by the author.
pub_privacy_control_text: Under Settings, Your data you can download everything as JSON or a space's transactions as CSV, and delete your account. Deleting removes your account and every space only you belong to. Demo accounts are deleted 48 hours after they start.
pub_privacy_questions_after: or open an issue on GitHub.

pub_security_description: How BudgetMaster protects your data, and how to report a problem.
pub_security_https: Connections use HTTPS only, enforced with HSTS.
pub_security_passwords: Passwords are stored as salted hashes (Better Auth, scrypt), never in plain text.
pub_security_rate: Repeated sign-in attempts are rate limited, and requests that change data must come from the app itself (CSRF protection).
pub_security_membership: Every request checks that you belong to the space it touches, and viewers cannot change anything.
pub_security_csp: A strict Content Security Policy only lets the app's own scripts run.
pub_security_report_before: Please report security problems privately through
pub_security_report_after: instead of a public issue. Include the steps to reproduce it. You will get an answer, and a fix before details are published. Please do not access other people's data or degrade the service while testing.
pub_privacy_s_push: If you turn on reminders on a device: its push address and keys. The browser's push service (from Google, Mozilla or Apple) delivers the reminder; it sees the reminder text, not your data.
pub_privacy_s_email: Emails (confirming your address, password reset, invites and the weekly summary if you turn it on) are sent through Resend.
